access_links.note: Direct link from the Mendeley Data API, 2026-10-01

description: Northwest Normal University publishes a version-three inventory of 2,918 hydropower stations across 31 mainland Chinese provinces and 11 river basins, with commissioning history from 1909 through 2025. The own Mendeley Data page gives DOI 10.17632/j529pxw9p8.3 and CC BY 4.0. It says station attributes include location, installed capacity, commissioning year, operating status and reservoir characteristics, assembled from international lists, Chinese statistics and archival reports. These fields can place hydro generation and storage assets in a power-capacity or hazard-resilience simulation with model-pypsa after network mapping. A caveat is that early and small stations depend on archival supplementation, and the provider’s completeness claim is not a measured guarantee for every decade. The landing page describes coordinate standardization and duplicate removal but does not expose a usable file-format list in the page read today. I opened the own version-three page and did not download data, validate coordinates or compare individual capacity figures with operators.
